text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the late sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Topaz - (built 1996) 18,500 dwt sold for $16.75 million.
Golden Panagia - (built 1976) 22,040 dwt sold for $2.2 million.
Corinthian Trader - (built 1973) 27,398 dwt sold fpor $1.4 million.
COMBINATION CARRIERS - Obo Venture - (built 1985) sold for $16 million including twelve months timecharter at $13,000 daily.
Thueringen - (built 1989) 19,710 dwt sold for $14 million each with 45 months timecharter.
Isla de la Plata - (built 1984) 34,543 dwt sold on subjects for $17.5 million.
OOCL Honour - (built 1989) 46,100 dwt sold for $35 million each.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - Seaways - (built 1969) 26,660 dwt sold for $186 delivery Bangladesh.
Esperos - (built 1973) 66,136 dwt sold for $176.5 delivery Vietnam.
Caravos Spirit - (built 1972) 113,826 dwt sold for $167 delivery Bangladesh.
Daiho - (built 1974) 37,176 dwt sold for $171.75 delivery Philippines.
Flinders Bay - (built 1969) 19,566 dwt to cash buyers for $177.50.
